why: Teams sessions draw no marker again (issue #1128): an unflagged Teams match goes back to the solid ring in team colors, so two teammates on the arena are told apart by nothing, while the page's stock strip, which `stripIdentityMarker` resolves as an FFA session would, still draws each player's shape marks. The strip and the ground then disagree, the one thing #1022 reserved `marks` against. FFA, co-op and single-player all stay green, so only a Teams cell can see it.
